BACKPORT: mac80211: Re-structure aqm debugfs output and keep CoDel stats per txq Currently the 'aqm' stats in mac80211 only keeps overlimit drop stats, not CoDel stats. This moves the CoDel stats into the txqi structure to keep them per txq in order to show them in debugfs. In addition, the aqm debugfs output is restructured by splitting it up into three files: One global per phy, one per netdev and one per station, in the appropriate directories. The files are all called aqm, and are only created if the driver supports the wake_tx_queue op (rather than emitting an error on open as previously). Signed-off-by: Toke Hiland-Jrgensen <toke@toke.dk> Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com> (cherry picked from commit 8d51dbb8c7fb5412f0935c20f66e27d2c63ef4a0) Resloved merge conflicts in debugfs.c BUG=b:131188415 TEST=None Signed-off-by: Kan Yan <kyan@google.com> Change-Id: I6d0926858eb82e6850247da3a8548f990d69b8ce Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1666238 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Julan Hsu <julanhsu@google.com>

UPSTREAM: fq.h: Port memory limit mechanism from fq_codel The reusable fairness queueing implementation (fq.h) lacks the memory usage limit that the fq_codel qdisc has. This means that small devices (e.g. WiFi routers) can run out of memory when flooded with a large number of packets. This ports the memory limit feature from fq_codel to fq.h. Signed-off-by: Toke Hiland-Jrgensen <toke@toke.dk> Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com> (cherry picked from commit 097b065b5cbfa3fd57b47f3c86d6baa96c30bf31) BUG=b:131188415 TEST=None Signed-off-by: Kan Yan <kyan@google.com> Change-Id: Id0735d296d191377e60511ace8fbef676068d07b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1666239 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Julan Hsu <julanhsu@google.com> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: fq_impl: Properly enforce memory limit The fq structure would fail to properly enforce the memory limit in the case where the packet being enqueued was bigger than the packet being removed to bring the memory usage down. So keep dropping packets until the memory usage is back below the limit. Also, fix the statistics for memory limit violations. ebuild for libmems and mems_setup mems_setup is meant to be a boot-time configuration tool. In its initial incarnation, it also included a bunch of useful wrapper classes around libiio, because that was the only logical place they could fit. The plan, however, is to use those same wrapper classes to support other clients of libiio in platform2. So, it makes sense to split mems_setup in two parts at this time: libmems: a library that wraps libiio and provides useful testing mocks and helpers around that, with proper platform2/ ergonomics, and easily accessible by the rest of the codebase. mems_setup: a boot-time configuration tool, solely responsible for initializating the sensors on a ChromeOS device, and the replacement for accelerometer-init.sh. BUG=chromium:969101 TEST=emerge and test mems_setup after the split Change-Id: I999a6598147c814a3cd3c73fddd0eac731b9ab34 Signed-off-by: Enrico Granata <egranata@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1666610 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Chirantan Ekbote <chirantan@chromium.org>

The CL also updates the README to cover the new procedure. BUG=b:134734017 TEST=1) Unit tests. New unit tests that failed before, and pass now, were added: WrongRestoredZPointGarbage, WrongPolicyi and more. run_oci: better integration with upstart Make it easier to launch run_oci from Upstart * Add a '--sigstop_when_ready' option to run_oci that causes it to raise SIGSTOP when the container is ready. This for use with Upstart's 'expect stop'. When the 'expect stop' stanza is present, Upstart waits until a job's main process raises SIGSTOP before considering it as started. It then immediately sends the child SIGCONT so it can continue execution. * Have 'run_oci run' create files under /run/containers as 'run_oci start' does. Our code has become dependent on these files, so 'run_oci run' needs to create them in order for it to be useful. * Forward signals run_oci receives to its child container. This requires a change to libcontiner. When stopping a job, Upstart will send SIGTERM to the job's main process. Since run_oci will be the main process, we need to have it forward the signal to its child, which will be the container. BUG=b:133248517 TEST=Launch 'run_oci run' from an upstart job Change-Id: I8814c09ea9c403b45fffe3e0f8ad499539c24d69 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1660104 Tested-by: Chris Morin <cmtm@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Chris Morin <cmtm@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org>
